title: Ava Introduces Kai Galosh

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: How are you finding life in The Luz?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How are you finding life in The Luz?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I hate being trapped.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hate being trapped.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Well, perhaps we can find a way to loosen the restrictions on your travel throughout the city.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, perhaps we can find a way to loosen the restrictions on your travel throughout the city.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I have a connection we can use. A hacker called Kai Galosh.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have a connection we can use. A hacker called Kai Galosh.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Who is he?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who is he?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: He helped Thaddeus get around some of the more... restrictive rules that could impede business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He helped Thaddeus get around some of the more... restrictive rules that could impede business.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Will he help us?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Will he help us?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I'm not sure. But Thaddeus was a... meticulous planner. I suspect that if we can find Kai Galosh, he will be expecting us. And I think Thaddeus might have left him instructions.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure. But Thaddeus was a... meticulous planner. I suspect that if we can find Kai Galosh, he will be expecting us. And I think Thaddeus might have left him instructions.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It will be good to move more freely around the city.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It will be good to move more freely around the city.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It will be good to move more freely around the city.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It will be good to move more freely around the city.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Local travel restrictions between districts within the LUZ don't concern CorpSec. They only care about people leaving it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Local travel restrictions between districts within the LUZ don't concern CorpSec. They only care about people leaving it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why is that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why is that?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: CorpSec assume if you have clearance for travel within the LUZ, you either have the resources to purchase travel passes, or you can afford a good bribe. Either way, they consider you "a commerce-complying citizen" and therefore, free to travel.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: CorpSec assume if you have clearance for travel within the LUZ, you either have the resources to purchase travel passes, or you can afford a good bribe. Either way, they consider you "a commerce-complying citizen" and therefore, free to travel.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can the hacker get us out of the LUZ?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can the hacker get us out of the LUZ?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Can the hacker get us out of the LUZ?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Can the hacker get us out of the LUZ?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Unlikely. CorpSec takes Localized Unity Zones very seriously.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Unlikely. CorpSec takes Localized Unity Zones very seriously.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Alright, let's try to find Kai Galosh.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, let's try to find Kai Galosh.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Alright, let's try to find Kai Galosh.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Alright, let's try to find Kai Galosh.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There are opportunities as well as limitations.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There are opportunities as well as limitations.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: There are opportunities as well as limitations.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: There are opportunities as well as limitations.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm trying to find ways to monetize the misery.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm trying to find ways to monetize the misery.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm trying to find ways to monetize the misery.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm trying to find ways to monetize the misery.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Couldn't working with a hacker get us in trouble?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Couldn't working with a hacker get us in trouble?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Couldn't working with a hacker get us in trouble?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Couldn't working with a hacker get us in trouble?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Count me in!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Count me in!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Isn't that dangerous?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Isn't that dangerous?
